moodles.depression3dsc: Everything feels so distant, so... empty. Is it even worth it to keep trying?
moodles.depression4dsc: <i>I will not go peacefully in the night...
moodles.impendingdoomdsc: Something is near. It wants a meal. Watch your back. Be vigilant.
moodles.focuseddsc: <i>If I am going down, I will be taking you with me.

seeGravel: I should make the most of what I find.
Sub-optimal, but I can make it work.
I must move, and move quickly.
It's a long way down. Not quite ideal.
...Sigh. Let's just get this over with.
Must this be such a dramatic event...?
eatGood: This should last me a while. Quite nice.
If I continue to eat in this manner, I may actually succeed in my mission.
Mmh. Excellent. I should get more of this if possible.
eatMediocre: I would prefer something more nutritious.
The last bite tasted almost edible.
A passing grade, if I'm generous.
Not terrible. But not good, either.
Not good. But not terrible, either.
This will sate me for the time being.
eatBad: Not worth the effort.
This makes my insides twist...
That tasted truly terrible. Atrocious.
That's an insult to good taste...
I regret trusting my hunger. Blegh.
And the new least edible award goes to...
I am regretting this...
I should not have eaten that.
Food is food. That, however, was not food.
Not my thing.
Not for me.
Not good.
I would have preferred to go hungry.
That could not be considered edible.
That should not be considered edible.
Someone else would have benefitted from that...
My digestive system does not appreciate this.
I worry I may become sick...
This would be better fed to one's worst enemy.
The potential of this food is lost on me.
I'm quite dissatisfied...
I feel nauseous just thinking about what was put into my body...
No, no, this will not do...
Gah... I don't like that.
I suspect too much of this will make me ill... I should really stop. Urf...
refuseEat: Survival is preferable to causing myself violent illness.
Negative. What a frankly insane idea...
Those thoughts aren't going to win.
I will not be doing that.
Fascinating. And I do mean that in the derogatory sense.
Ideally, I wouldn't even consider such a possibility...
I will not be making myself consume that. It wouldn't help a single thing.
tired: Lack of rest makes for poor attention.
I tire. I should find a place to rest.
To keep going would be foolish.
Come, now, when has a little sleepiness stopped me?
I tire... I must rest. It is not optional.
verytired: I cannot... continue... Not like this...
I cannot collapse. Not here, not now...
What a seductive demon sleep is... Tch...
confused: What are you doing to me...
wakeup: I rise... But do not ask me to shine.
It seems I live another day.
Waking up... Okay. Time to continue.
No one look at me for a moment.
I must carry on with dignity...
sick: This is wrong. I feel... nausea?
My immune system was supposed to be better than this.
vomit: Ggguh... nngh... I... did not appreciate that...
Mmmuh... hff... hff... I need a moment... please.
Don't... anyone look at me. Please...
Ouhhhh... I don't mean to be so... revolting...
vomitblood: This... is... not what I had in mind for today.
Gkkkh... I am... slowly drowning in my own blood...
Hrk... every part of my body... disliked that...
full: It's nice to be so well-fed.
Thank you for this meal. I'm good to go now.
hungry: I should seek out something to eat. Preferrably something edible.
Where to find a half-decent meal...
starving: An emptiness chews at my insides...
Such hunger... how unkind of this world...
thirsty: I should locate a water source.
Anything to wet my tongue that ISN'T bacteria-infested groundwater?
I should prepare clean water, if I don't already have some.
Finding water is my top priority.
Dehydration is quite serious. I should quench my thirst the moment I can.
dehydrated: Thirst is a stupid thing to die of...
C-come on... I can't die here... not of dehydration, no less...
I'm... dehydrated. This is an issue...
limbmuscle: A doctor would be most ideal. A bruise kit would be a close fifth to that.
Come on, <limb>. I don't care if you're hurt, keep going...
I've injured the muscles of my <limb>, it seems. Unfortunate.
Perhaps some rest and care is due, given how my <limb> isn't working as I'd hope.
limbinfected: An infection must have set into my <limb>...
What is going on with my <limb>...?
I must use antiseptic on my <limb>.
limbskin: I risk infection if I do not bandage my <limb> properly.
sad: I must stay vigilant. I must stay alert.
These are not the circumstances I appreciate finding myself in.
It pulls at the chest, at the throat...
One paw in front of the other...
I must simply outlast this storm.
gloomy: I wish to escape this. Despite it all, I wish to escape...
There is a melancholy that tugs me down.
Take this slow, if I must...
miserable: There is a pit in my body. It hungers. I don't.
My thoughts are full of blood.
angeronitem: AH-!!!! I'm sorry, little thing. I am sorry for what I've done to you.
I'm sorry. I'm sorry. I'm so very sorry...
. . . I'm... I am not proud of my actions.
suicide: Please... p-please, let me out. Please, let me out of here...
I must get out of here. I must. NOW.
refuse: Ah... My body will not move.
You may not force my hand.
What made you think you were in control?
Now now, sit quietly and be good.
You are not in control here.
I will not be your puppet.
bleeding: I'll get dirty if this bleeding continues...
That is not where the blood should be.
I know better than to underestimate this.
Steady, steady. It is only a little blood.
bleedingheavy: It's- it's different than... in the drills...
I can't apply pressure...! T-too much...!
Don't... panic. That's the worst thing I could do right now...
Too much blood, that's too much blood...
Not... my preferred amount of blood loss...
This amount of blood is... not ideal.
steponglass: Must the glass cut through so deeply?
seecorpse: ...I wish I had gotten here sooner.
Oh... May you rest in peace.
Oh... no, you poor dear... Ah...
seecorpsedesensitized: Your pain is over now. Rest.
Try to be more careful next time, yes?
The death statistics must be off the charts.
If I had the time to mourn every body I see...
Your misfortune is my fortune, I suppose...
Go back to sleep, stranger.
Please, don't mind me. I'm only passing through.
Thank you for your contribution.
Terribly sorry. I'm sure someone will miss you.
...And that's that.
There are far too many bodies.
You still deserve acknowledgement.
Rest in peace, stranger.
Rest in peace, friend.
What generous gifts you give.
Rest well. I will keep your possessions close.
Take it easy. Your struggle has ended. You can rest.
Please, be at peace, friend.
I hope it was a swift death.
I hope you didn't suffer.
seecorpsesuicidal: Your death was a mercy. I promise you that.
You will never shed a tear again...
I'm sorry it wasn't over sooner.
A grim parade, spiralling down eternally...
Death remains all around. It seeps into every corner.
Ah, another corpse. Mmh, I envy you... n-no, no, snap out of it, come on...
breakcorpse: Ah, yes... Defiling corpses is surely the best part of my day...
Not the cleanest break I've seen...
I'm almost certain that would be considered disrespectful.
Whatever happened to respecting the dead? ...Sigh.
cold: What do I have stored for this occasion...?
This is below my ideal temperature.
warm: My fur is too thick for this.
This is above my ideal temperature.
Surely I have layers that I can remove to become more comfortable, yes?
exerted: I would benefit from a moment of respite...
I may be stubborn, but I still need my rest.
emaciated: No meat is left on my body...
My frame is much too... little.
obese: I can see the fat building up on me. Quite impressive, really.
I might have eaten more than I should have.
I have eaten well... Quite well.
My chest is not appreciating how much I have consumed.
opiated: All of my worries seem so strangely far away, now...
I could take more of this. It's so very good to me...
Fuck... this is nice. This is very nice... I don't mind this at all...
Oh... Is this what it feels like? To be happy...?
My fur is a bit tingly. It feels... nice...
opiatedsad: It is alright... I have done enough. I can relax now...
opiatewithdrawal: It isn't addiction. I could quit at any time.
Mmh... something is wrong. A sickness, perhaps...
F-fuck... I need more of those... ah... those drugs. I'd like more...
My head is pouding. This is... uncomfortable...
I could use another opiate hit right about now. It'd really hit the spot...
How about, if I get to the next zone, I give myself another shot? A-as a treat...
I... I do not feel well.
Mmh... I crave more of those painkillers. They were quite comforting.
pain: It is not agonizing. I can continue.
hitbycreature: Who gave you permission to touch me?!
encumbered: Is everything I am holding truly this useful...?
I must be careful. A heavy load makes for a more difficult getaway.
Honestly, I am carrying a tad much...
Is this amount of belongings necessary...?
Work smarter, not harder. Come, now...
watchlike: You are a useful little watch-thing.
I approve. The watch may stay.
Thank you, my dear watch. I appreciate your vigilance.
You're quite the useful fellow, aren't you, my little technological friend?
drillend: What a bumpy and altogether unpleasant transit...
What a fascinatingly jostling device that was...
I should be careful, lest I get landsick...
...I don't mean to be ungrateful, but I'm glad to be out of that drill.
loud: Gah... Please, let's keep it quieter in the future.
Nngh... I may need some sort of ear protection.
Urf... My sense of balance has been shaken...
murderregret: . . . I should not have done that. I should not be permitted to do that. I... I'm covered in blood...
tradeemeet: Hello. I bear no ill will.
Let us trade while our paths meet, yes?
lastmoments: Nh... no... Please don't... let me... fade... away...
I'm... I'm not done...... Not done.........
Buh... but I... I haven't made my mark... yet... I.....
selfdestruct: ... I always knew, deep down, that I was just a pawn.
Let's get this over with quickly.
Now it's time for my head to burst. Good day.
How... loud. I'm sure this could have been fashioned better...
tradermeetgood: Don't be a stranger. Come on in.
tradermeetbad: Who... Well, I suppose I have no choice but to watch you make yourself at home, now, do I?
traderhugsuccess: Thank you. That was... mmmh... comforting.
Ah. I hope that helped, then?
traderhugfail: No, thank you. I... do not want touch at the moment.
traderhagglefail: No, thank you. Please reconsider your actions.
tradergiveitem: This will benefit the both of us.
tradergiveitemrefuse: I am not interested in farther trade at the moment.

traderbuyfail: Mmm... I do not feel that's an even trade.
traderbuyfailmaxvalue: No... I am satisfied. Thank you.
traderwarning: If you do not leave, I will remove you by force.
tradercombat: I warned you to leave, yet here you are...!
traderthreatensuccess: Fine. Take what you want. But watch your back.
traderlightbreak: Sigh... Get out of here. Now.
I don't have the patience for this...
traderwakegreet: Welcome back to the land of the living.
traderseegun: Sigh. Stow your weapon, I've no interest in communicating at gunpoint.
traderseehurt: Ah, you're injured. Here, take any bandage you need. On me.
tradermovefail: I have no reason to move for you.
vomitresponse: Oh, dear... Just, ah, let it all out, yes...
vomitbloodresponse: You appear to have a case of internal bleeding.
Procoagulant or a chest drain may be ideal, in your situation.
hungryresponse: ...You seem to want me to do something about that.
thirstyresponse: You're welcome to get a campfire going. Then you may purify water.
sadresponse: One paw in front of the other.
The peace comes later, I'm afraid.
You must simply outlast this storm.
Keep your emotions in check. They seem to be escaping you.
depressedresponse: Come, now. You are not your worst moments.
Breathe... you must continue to breathe.
selfharmresponse: Does the cave thank you when you spill blood onto it? No, it doesn't. So why give so freely?
hotresponse: This pod should have a cooling system.
coldresponse: Warmth does tend to keep us alive, yes.
bleedingresponse: While it isn't enjoyable to see the blood of others, I must admit, I prefer not to be the one bleeding.
painresponse: I'd take your pain, if I could.
Take a deep breath. You can get through this. In, and out.
dirtyresponse: Yes, you are quite indecent. I agree.
encumberedresponse: Perhaps there is another method of arranging your things that won't cause spinal damage.
dyingresponse: May your soul rest in peace.
...A sorry sight you are. I apologize.

dying: Somehow, you manage to make even dying into a boring event.

To be at ease. To be calm.
Slow and steady wins the race.
Let us pause, then.
It's not as if I am going anywhere.
Slow and steady.
Overconfidence will get me nowhere. I must remain humble, no matter how well I end up doing.
Remain level-headed, and things will fall into place with time.
Acceptable. I will wait as long as is needed.

Let us continue to be reasonable.
I must be cautious.
Cautious, but not paranoid. Careful, but not hesitant...
Calculate the risks. Then, proceed.
Perhaps we should rest and try again tomorrow.
Wait... calm... and proceed.

Perhaps now is a good time for some reflection.

Get some rest.
